title: What your odds are really saying
voiceInstructions: Confident sports-explainer delivery. Upbeat and quick, but every number clear. Slight emphasis on the numbers.

scenes.title: −150 doesn’t mean what you think.
scenes.kicker: Here’s what your odds are really saying.
scenes.say: Minus one fifty doesn't mean what you think it means.

scenes.title: Every price hides a probability
scenes.say: Every price hides a probability. Minus one fifty means the book is saying this hits sixty percent of the time.
scenes.caption: Every price hides a probability. −150 means the book says this hits 60% of the time.

scenes.title: Now price both sides
scenes.say: The other side, plus one thirty, is forty-three and a half percent. Together that's one hundred three and a half. The extra three and a half is the book's cut.
scenes.caption: The other side, +130, is 43.5%. Together that’s 103.5%. The extra 3.5% is the book’s cut.

scenes.title: True Prob AI builds its own number
scenes.say: True Prob AI builds its own number for every prop, from minutes, shot volume, and pace, and puts it right next to the price.
scenes.caption: True Prob AI builds its own number for every prop, from minutes, shot volume and pace, and puts it right next to the price.

points: A plain-English reason for each pick
